text:
10. 5. 3. 2. 

Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya dasadhammā bhāvetabbā. Katame dasa: aniccasaññā anattasaññā āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā aṭṭhikasaññā pulavakasaññā vinīlakasaññā vipubbakasaññā vicchiddakasaññā uddhumātakasaññā. Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime dasadhammā bhāvetabbāti.
